sentences.text: You see a flash of lightning.
Then you wait.
Then you hear the thunder.
Children learn to count the seconds.
Three seconds is about one kilometre.
This works because light is fast.
sentences.translationRu: Это работает, потому что свет быстрый.

sentences.text: The flash arrives almost at once.
Sound is slow, so it comes later.
But what is thunder?
Many people think the clouds hit each other.
Clouds are water and air.
They cannot hit anything.
sentences.translationRu: Они ни обо что не могут удариться.

sentences.text: Thunder comes from the lightning itself.
Lightning is unbelievably hot.
About thirty thousand degrees.
That is five times hotter than the sun.
sentences.translationRu: Это в пять раз горячее поверхности Солнца.

sentences.text: Not the middle of the sun. The surface.
And it happens in less than a second.
sentences.translationRu: И происходит это меньше чем за секунду.

sentences.text: Air gets very hot very fast.
Hot air needs more space.
So it pushes outwards, hard.
Faster than sound can travel.
This makes a wave of pressure.
That wave is the thunder.
So thunder is not a hit.
It is air getting out of the way.
Then the air cools in a moment.
And falls back into the empty space.
That makes the long rolling sound.
Lightning is not a short line.
It can be many kilometres long.
sentences.translationRu: Она может быть длиной в много километров.

sentences.text: The near part arrives first.
The far part arrives later.
So one flash gives you a long noise.
sentences.translationRu: Поэтому одна вспышка даёт долгий шум.

sentences.text: A very close strike sounds different.
It is a crack, not a roll.
Because all of it arrives together.

title: The sea is blue, and not because of the sky

sentences.text: The sea is blue.
Almost everybody explains this the same way.
It reflects the sky.
That is a small part of the truth.
It is not the main reason.
Water itself is blue.
Not much, but a little.
A glass of water looks clear.
There is not enough of it to see the colour.
sentences.translationRu: Её просто мало, чтобы увидеть цвет.

sentences.text: Fill a swimming pool and look down.
Now you can see it.
A white pool still looks blue.
sentences.translationRu: Белый бассейн всё равно выглядит синим.

sentences.text: Even indoors, with no sky at all.
sentences.translationRu: Даже в помещении, где неба нет вовсе.

sentences.text: Sunlight is made of many colours.
sentences.translationRu: Солнечный свет состоит из многих цветов.

sentences.text: Water absorbs some of them.
Red goes first.
After a few metres, red is gone.
Then orange. Then yellow.
Blue travels furthest.
So the light coming back to your eye
sentences.translationRu: Значит, свет, возвращающийся к твоему глазу,

sentences.text: has had the red taken out of it.
What is left is blue.
Divers know this very well.
Ten metres down, everything is blue-green.
Blood from a cut looks dark green.
There is no red light left to reflect.
Turn on a torch and the red comes back.
This is why underwater photos need a light.
sentences.translationRu: Поэтому для подводных снимков нужен свет.

sentences.text: Not because it is dark.
Because the colours are missing.
sentences.translationRu: А потому, что цветов не хватает.

sentences.text: Seas are not all the same blue.
Some are green, some are almost brown.
That is about what is in the water.
sentences.translationRu: Это уже про то, что в воде.

sentences.text: Tiny plants make it green.
Sand and mud from rivers make it brown.
sentences.translationRu: Песок и ил из рек делают её бурой.

sentences.text: The clearest water is the emptiest.
Beautiful, and almost nothing lives there.
sentences.translationRu: Красиво — и почти ничего там не живёт.

title: The bird that decorates a stage

sentences.text: In Australia and New Guinea
there is a bird that builds something strange.
sentences.translationRu: живёт птица, которая строит нечто странное.

sentences.text: Not a nest. The nest is somewhere else.
sentences.translationRu: Не гнездо. Гнездо в другом месте.

sentences.text: This is a structure built only to be looked at.
sentences.translationRu: Это постройка, созданная только для того, чтобы на неё смотрели.

sentences.text: It is called a bower.
The male spends months on it.
Two walls of sticks, pushed into the ground.
sentences.translationRu: Две стенки из веточек, воткнутых в землю.

sentences.text: An avenue between them, wide enough to walk.
sentences.translationRu: Между ними проход, достаточный, чтобы пройти.

sentences.text: Then he decorates the ground in front.
sentences.translationRu: Потом он украшает площадку перед ней.

sentences.text: And this is where it gets odd.
Each species prefers a colour.
One collects only blue things.
Flowers, feathers, berries, beetle wings.
Near towns, they collect plastic.
sentences.translationRu: Рядом с посёлками они собирают пластик.

sentences.text: Bottle tops, pens, clothes pegs, straws.
A bower can hold hundreds of objects.
sentences.translationRu: В беседке могут быть сотни предметов.

sentences.text: Sorted carefully by colour and by kind.
sentences.translationRu: Аккуратно разложенных по цвету и виду.

sentences.text: They steal from each other constantly.
sentences.translationRu: Они постоянно воруют друг у друга.

sentences.text: A male will visit a rival's bower
wreck part of it, and take the best pieces.
Then there is the part discovered recently.
sentences.translationRu: А потом — то, что открыли недавно.

sentences.text: One species arranges stones and bones
sentences.translationRu: Один вид раскладывает камешки и косточки

sentences.text: along the avenue by size.
Small ones close to the entrance.
Large ones further away.
From where the female stands,
sentences.translationRu: С того места, где стоит самка,

sentences.text: this makes the ground look even.
Which makes the male look larger.
It is forced perspective.
The trick painters use, and film sets.
Researchers tested it by moving the stones.
The males put them back within days.
sentences.translationRu: Самцы вернули всё на место за несколько дней.

sentences.text: And the ones with the best illusion
sentences.translationRu: А те, у кого иллюзия выходила лучше,

sentences.text: had more success with females.
So the bower is not a home.
It is an argument, made of objects.
About how much time he can afford to waste.
sentences.translationRu: О том, сколько времени он может позволить себе потратить.

title: Stale bread is not dry bread

sentences.text: Fresh bread is soft.
Two days later it is hard.
The obvious explanation is drying.
Water leaves the bread, so it hardens.
That explanation is wrong.
There is a simple way to show it.
Seal bread in a bag so nothing escapes.
sentences.translationRu: Запечатай хлеб в пакет, чтобы ничего не уходило.

sentences.text: It still goes stale.
The water is still there.
It has only moved.
Bread is mostly starch.
Raw starch is packed in tight bundles.
sentences.translationRu: Сырой крахмал уложен в плотные пучки.

sentences.text: Baking breaks the bundles apart.
Water gets in between the pieces.
And the whole thing becomes soft.
Then, slowly, the starch tidies itself.
sentences.translationRu: А потом крахмал медленно наводит порядок.

sentences.text: The loose pieces line up again.
They rebuild their tight structure.
And they squeeze the water out as they go.
The water moves into the crust.
Which is why stale bread has a soft crust.
sentences.translationRu: Поэтому у чёрствого хлеба корка мягкая.

sentences.text: And a hard middle.
Fresh bread is the opposite.
So the process is not loss.
It is rearrangement, inside.
Which has a useful consequence.
The process can be reversed.
Heat the bread and the bundles break again.
sentences.translationRu: Нагрей хлеб — и пучки снова разрушатся.

sentences.text: The water goes back where it was.
Warm stale bread is almost fresh.
For about an hour.
Then it stales faster than before.
Temperature decides the speed.
The starch rearranges fastest just above freezing.
sentences.translationRu: Крахмал перестраивается быстрее всего чуть выше нуля.

sentences.text: So a fridge is the worst place for bread.
sentences.translationRu: То есть холодильник — худшее место для хлеба.

sentences.text: It goes stale several times faster there.
sentences.translationRu: Там он черствеет в несколько раз быстрее.

sentences.text: A freezer stops it almost completely.
sentences.translationRu: А морозилка останавливает процесс почти полностью.

sentences.text: Too cold for the starch to move at all.
sentences.translationRu: Слишком холодно, чтобы крахмал вообще двигался.

title: Headphones that remove sound by adding sound

sentences.text: Put on noise-cancelling headphones in a plane.
The engine noise disappears.
Not muffled. Gone.
And you have not blocked your ears.
The headphones are playing something.
What they are playing is the noise.
sentences.translationRu: И проигрывают они этот самый шум.

sentences.text: Upside down.
Sound is a wave of pressure.
Air pushed slightly together, then apart.
Over and over, hundreds of times a second.
sentences.translationRu: Снова и снова, сотни раз в секунду.

sentences.text: Now imagine a second wave.
Identical in every way, but flipped.
sentences.translationRu: Во всём такую же, но перевёрнутую.

sentences.text: Where the first pushes, the second pulls.
Add them together and they cancel.
The air does not move at all.
Which is silence.
Two loud sounds making nothing.
Inside the headphone there is a microphone.
Actually usually two.
One outside, listening to the world.
One inside, listening to your ear.
A chip reads the outside microphone.
Calculates the opposite wave.
And plays it, in time to meet the real one.
sentences.translationRu: И проигрывает её так, чтобы встретить настоящую.

sentences.text: The timing has to be almost perfect.
A fraction of a thousandth of a second late
and you are adding noise instead.
This is why it works best on engines.
sentences.translationRu: Поэтому лучше всего это работает на двигателях.

sentences.text: Low sounds are long and repetitive.
A long wave gives the chip time to react.
sentences.translationRu: Длинная волна даёт чипу время среагировать.

sentences.text: And a repeating one can be predicted.
Speech is neither.
It is high, short and never repeats.
sentences.translationRu: Она высокая, короткая и не повторяется.

sentences.text: So the announcement still gets through.
Which annoys people and is not a fault.
sentences.translationRu: Это раздражает людей и не является браком.

sentences.text: It is the same limit as the engine hum.
sentences.translationRu: Это то же ограничение, что и с гулом двигателя.

sentences.text: Seen from the other end.

title: Why time zones are not straight lines

sentences.text: Look at a map of the world's time zones.
sentences.translationRu: Посмотри на карту часовых поясов мира.

sentences.text: They should be twenty-four neat stripes.
sentences.translationRu: Это должны быть двадцать четыре ровные полосы.

sentences.text: Each one fifteen degrees wide.
They are not.
They bend around countries.
They swallow whole regions.
In places they run almost sideways.
Every bend is a decision somebody made.
Before railways, time was local.
sentences.translationRu: До железных дорог время было местным.

sentences.text: Noon was when the sun was highest.
sentences.translationRu: Полдень был, когда солнце выше всего.

sentences.text: Which happens at a different moment
sentences.translationRu: А это происходит в разный момент

sentences.text: in every town going east or west.
sentences.translationRu: в каждом городе к востоку или западу.

sentences.text: Nobody cared, because nobody could travel fast.
sentences.translationRu: Никого это не волновало: быстро не ездили.

sentences.text: A train changed that immediately.
A timetable cannot use local noon.
sentences.translationRu: Расписание не может опираться на местный полдень.

sentences.text: So railways invented standard time.
sentences.translationRu: И железные дороги придумали стандартное время.

sentences.text: Companies first. Then countries.
The zones that resulted are political.
China is the clearest example.
It is wide enough for five zones.
sentences.translationRu: Он широк настолько, что вместил бы пять поясов.

sentences.text: It uses one.
In the far west the sun rises
sentences.translationRu: На дальнем западе страны солнце встаёт

sentences.text: at what the clock calls ten in the morning.
sentences.translationRu: в то, что часы называют десятью утра.

sentences.text: People there keep an unofficial local time
sentences.translationRu: Люди там держат неофициальное местное время

sentences.text: alongside the official one.
Spain is another.
It sits at the longitude of Britain.
And keeps the time of central Europe.
The change was made in the 1940s
to match a neighbour, and never undone.
sentences.translationRu: чтобы совпасть с соседом, и не отменили.

sentences.text: Which is why Spanish evenings run late.
Dinner at ten is nine by the sun.
sentences.translationRu: Ужин в десять — это девять по солнцу.

sentences.text: Some zones are not whole hours.
India is half an hour off.
Nepal is three quarters.
Which was a deliberate statement
about not being part of the neighbour.
sentences.translationRu: о том, что они не часть соседа.

sentences.text: A time zone looks like geography.
It is a list of agreements
about who a place wants to share a morning with.
sentences.translationRu: с кем место хочет делить утро.

title: The people paid to describe a flavour exactly

sentences.text: Somewhere in most large food companies
sentences.translationRu: Почти в каждой крупной пищевой компании

sentences.text: there is a room with small booths in it.
Separate, lit in a neutral colour,
with a hatch through which samples arrive.
sentences.translationRu: с окошком, через которое подают образцы.

sentences.text: The people who sit in them are not judges.
They are instruments.
A sensory panel does not say what is nice.
sentences.translationRu: Сенсорная панель не говорит, что вкусно.

sentences.text: Liking is measured separately, on the public.
A panel measures what is there.
Bitterness, on a scale, with a number.
Reproducible by a different panellist
in a different country next year.
sentences.translationRu: в другой стране в следующем году.

sentences.text: Getting there takes months of training.
Candidates are screened first.
Not for a superior palate.
Most people's senses are adequate.
They are screened for consistency.
Give somebody the same sample twice.
sentences.translationRu: Дай человеку один и тот же образец дважды.

sentences.text: A good panellist gives the same number.
sentences.translationRu: Хороший участник назовёт то же число.

sentences.text: A great many people do not.
Then comes the vocabulary.
A panel agrees on terms and on anchors.
sentences.translationRu: Панель договаривается о терминах и опорных точках.

sentences.text: Not fruity, which means nothing shared.
sentences.translationRu: Не «фруктовый» — в этом нет ничего общего.

sentences.text: A named compound at a named concentration.
Tasted, agreed, and used as a ruler.
Astringency is calibrated against a solution
everybody on the panel has tasted.
So a five means the same thing to all of them.
sentences.translationRu: Чтобы пятёрка значила для всех одно и то же.

sentences.text: The discipline is in what is excluded.
Booths are separate so nobody sees a face.
sentences.translationRu: Кабинки раздельные, чтобы никто не видел лиц.

sentences.text: Samples carry three-digit random codes.
Never A and B, because B is second.
sentences.translationRu: Никогда A и B, потому что B — второй.

sentences.text: Lighting is sometimes coloured
to hide a difference in appearance.
sentences.translationRu: чтобы скрыть разницу во внешнем виде.

sentences.text: Because appearance moves the answer
sentences.translationRu: Потому что внешний вид сдвигает ответ

sentences.text: more than almost anything else.
What the job teaches, panellists say,
is how unreliable an untrained answer is.
Not because people lie.
Because a taste arrives already interpreted,
sentences.translationRu: А потому, что вкус приходит уже истолкованным,

sentences.text: and the interpretation is doing most of the work.
sentences.translationRu: и толкование делает бóльшую часть работы.

title: Why a wound leaves a mark at all

sentences.text: Cut your skin and it closes.
What grows back is not skin.
It is a patch that does the job of skin
without any of its structure.
Normal skin has fibres woven in a mesh.
sentences.translationRu: В нормальной коже волокна сплетены в сетку.

sentences.text: Running in many directions at once.
Which is why it stretches in any direction.
sentences.translationRu: Поэтому она тянется в любую сторону.

sentences.text: Scar tissue lays its fibres in parallel.
All in one alignment, tightly packed.
Strong along that line and stiff across it.
sentences.translationRu: Прочно вдоль этой линии и жёстко поперёк.

sentences.text: It also grows nothing else.
sentences.translationRu: И больше в нём ничего не растёт.

sentences.text: No hair, no sweat glands, no oil glands.
sentences.translationRu: Ни волос, ни потовых желёз, ни сальных.

sentences.text: A scar cannot sweat or tan.
sentences.translationRu: Рубец не потеет и не загорает.

sentences.text: The obvious question is why.
The body clearly knows how to build skin.
It did it once already.
sentences.translationRu: Один раз оно её уже построило.

sentences.text: The answer is speed.
An open wound is an open door.
For most of human history
an infection was the likely cause of death.
Building proper skin takes weeks.
Laying down a fast patch takes days.
Evolution has no interest in the appearance
of somebody who survived.
It closed the door. That was the whole brief.
sentences.translationRu: Дверь закрыта. Это было всё задание.

sentences.text: The evidence for this is developmental.
A foetus in the early months
heals without scarring at all.
Perfect skin, with hair follicles, every time.
sentences.translationRu: Идеальная кожа, с волосяными фолликулами, каждый раз.

sentences.text: The environment is sterile, so there is no rush.
The capacity was never lost.
It is switched off when the risk appears.
Several animals keep it for life.
One salamander regrows an entire limb
sentences.translationRu: Один вид саламандр отращивает конечность целиком

sentences.text: with bone, nerves and pattern intact.
sentences.translationRu: с костью, нервами и сохранённым рисунком.

sentences.text: It also has a slower, more careful response.
sentences.translationRu: И у неё медленнее, более осторожная реакция.

sentences.text: Medicine is now trying to move the switch.
sentences.translationRu: Медицина сейчас пытается сдвинуть этот переключатель.

sentences.text: Not to heal faster, which we can already do.
sentences.translationRu: Не чтобы заживлять быстрее — это мы уже умеем.

sentences.text: To heal more slowly and more completely.
sentences.translationRu: А чтобы заживлять медленнее и полнее.

sentences.text: Which is an unusual thing to ask of a body
that spent a million years learning the opposite.
